Initial release of PostHero — schedule and publish social media posts across 8 platforms.

- Schedule, draft, and publish posts to LinkedIn, Twitter/X, Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, TikTok, Threads, and Bluesky via the PostHero API.
- Manage content and get analytics from a simple conversational interface.
- Support for character limits, per-platform content overrides, and media attachments.
- Workflow guidance for account selection, scheduling, and post creation.
- Includes full API reference and usage instructions.
